How the data works

  • chord: root, optional accidental ("b" or "#", printed as ♭ ♯), quality (superscript, e.g. "m7"), bass (slash bass, e.g. "C" or "Bb").
  • strings: 6 entries, left to right as drawn. kind is fretted (with fret and optional finger), muted (gray X on a fret), open (nothing drawn) or mutedOpen (x above the nut).
  • windowStartFret: the fret in the top row. Above fret 1, set fretLabelRow (0 to 3) to print the fret number beside that row.
  • barres: fret, from and to strings, and the sounding spans drawn dark inside the gray bar.
  • The full schema is src/model/voicing.schema.json.
